thread:
alex: Customer acme-eu hit repeated JSON parsing failures in json_mode streaming. Error from Python SDK: JSONDecodeError 'Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 742'. Customer upgraded to SDK 0.9.3 yesterday and started seeing failures behind our EU gateway. Repro attached below.

maria: Can you paste the raw stream fragment + exact SDK/version? Is this impacting prod or a single request? -> priority? :warning:

alex: Raw fragment (customer redacted ids):
```
{"id":"resp_1","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"{\"items\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"text\":\"Hello \\u0000 wor\"} ]}"}}]
{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"ld","meta":{...}}}
```
Log trace on their side:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/app/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood_sdk/stream.py", line 128, in _iter_json
    obj = json.loads(buffer)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.11/json/__init__.py", line 293, in loads
    return _default_decoder.decode(s)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 742 (char 741)
```
They also see occasional `Invalid \x00 in string` from downstream parser in Go.

jon: Which exact call pattern are they using? The streaming framing change in 0.9.3 sends partial JSON fragments for large fields (we push deltas as they arrive). The bug sounds like the client is calling `json.loads` per incoming chunk instead of buffering.

alex: Repro steps (minimal):
Python:
```python
# naive reader
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model="x", json_mode="json"):
    print(json.loads(chunk))  # fails on fragmented content
```
TS:
```ts
for await (const chunk of client.responses.stream({ model: 'x', json_mode: 'json' })) {
  JSON.parse(chunk) // crashes on fragment
}
```
Go (simplified):
```go
r := client.StreamResponses(ctx, req)
for {
  chunk, err := r.Next()
  var o map[string]any
  json.Unmarshal([]byte(chunk), &o) // invalid character '\x00' or unexpected EOF
}
```

kevin: Short-term mitigation: ask customer to set `json_mode="delimited"` or use the SDK helper that buffers into complete JSON objects (we ship `stream_json_objects()` in some clients). Long-term: client libs must buffer partial fragments and only call the parser once the object is complete (balanced braces or newline delimiter). Also handle escaped control chars properly (\u0000).

jon: I'll add a failing unit test for fragmented escape sequences + control chars. Plan: add buffer state machine that concatenates chunks, increments/decrements brace depth, and treats string escapes correctly (so a `\"` inside strings doesn't break counting). Owner: @kevin for release patch. Target: 0.9.4 patch with tests + changelog.

maria: Escalating to P1 for acme-eu (paid enterprise). Customer impact: multiple requests failing, some retries causing latency spikes. Notified customer of workaround (switch to `delimited` or disable streaming) and ETA 24h for patch. Please add Slack thread update when patch lands. :rotating_light:

ci-bot: Preview patch created: https://ci.internal/redwood/patches/8923 (includes unit test for fragmented \u0000 + NDJSON fallback) :white_check_mark:

alex: Confirmed customer can reproduce with a small script. Workaround (temporary) accepted: use `stream_text=True` and parse completes, or `json_mode='delimited'`. I'll coordinate release testing in eu-prod and let ops know to monitor error rates.

jon: Note for release notes: call out that streaming clients prior to 0.9.4 may attempt to parse incomplete JSON frames when `json_mode='json'`. Recommend upgrade and link to migration snippet.

kevin: I'll own the patch and cut RC after CI passes. Thanks all.
